sourceDocs.exactNeedle: S02 — S02 Capability Genome and task taxonomy
### M14: Model Registry & Empirical Model Cards
Sixteen NEW OPEN/UNRATED M14 S01 owner questions

dimensions.title: Typed task inputs, outputs and temporal or structured shape
dimensions.caveat: An advertised image/video/audio/3D label does not prove actual input/output type, exact M04 Scene IR operator or native provider compatibility.

dimensions.title: Intent, transformation and semantic constraints
dimensions.caveat: M03 creative intent and M04 IR remain canonical; vendor task declarations cannot alter accepted M02 production graph or waive M01 fidelity.

dimensions.title: S01 package closure and operator declarations
dimensions.caveat: A matching weight hash without tokenizer, adapter or qualified custom-code revision is not a complete model or qualified task capability.

dimensions.title: Declared precision, backend, hardware and capacity requirements
dimensions.caveat: A self-reported VRAM number or local cache entry is not M07 hardware evidence, M08 benchmark, M09 joint grant or M11 worker authority.

dimensions.title: Task-specific quality, population and reliability claims
dimensions.caveat: A synthetic test or provider score does not establish M01 approval, M08 representative measurement or a numeric model ranking or threshold.

dimensions.title: Per-tenant rights, issuer, validity, expiry and revocation caveats
dimensions.caveat: Unratified M18/M53/M54/M58/M60 contracts mean SPDX labels, copied model cards and signatures cannot grant use, storage or publication.

alternatives.title: Flat provider task tags
alternatives.tradeoffs: Simple catalog lookup but ambiguous input/output, mutable labels and no authenticated operator, quality or owner scope.

alternatives.title: Typed task and IO capability matrix
alternatives.tradeoffs: Separates candidate IO shape and unknown support but depends on qualified M03/M04 and S01 composite revision evidence.

alternatives.title: Versioned model/task/dependency graph
alternatives.tradeoffs: Expresses claim-level provenance and version conflicts but needs real M14/M16/M18 trust and complete redaction semantics.

alternatives.title: Future authenticated at-use capability proof
alternatives.tradeoffs: Requires actual independent M14/M18/M53/M54/M60 owner rights and representative M08 evidence before any such receipt exists.

questions.question: How can M14 represent exact typed task IO without redefining M03 creative intent or M04 frozen multimodal intermediate representation?
Which tokenizer, weights, adapter and rights revision must qualify future self-reported text tasks and embeddings for a given tenant?
How does an image-generation task preserve M01 quality vetoes and M04 edit semantics across versions without claimed empirical proof?
Which video frame cadence, temporal window and exact source revision are mere claims until representative M08 empirical tests exist?
How may audio and speech claims represent future actual persona consent and source rights without inventing M53/M54 approval?
How can 3D task vocabulary represent geometry, rig and material support without claiming native DCC plugin or M60 process authority?
Which joint media IO contract preserves mandatory M02/M06 lineage, exact M04 semantics and M01 quality across partial output cases?
Which typed structured extraction or planning operation remains a claim until independent M16 compiler operator coverage is proven?
How must self-reported, inferred and unknown task declarations be kept from promotion to owner-verified actual availability?
What exact independent issuer, tenant, expiry and revocation source is required before an OWNER_VERIFIED capability may be represented?
Which representative M08 protocol and M07 hardware fingerprint would qualify actual future quality, latency and VRAM per revision?
Which compiled backend, precision and attention-operator statements must stay hints until M13/M16/M17 owner qualification?
How can model availability and residency hints avoid granting M09 multi-member resource leases, M11 dispatch or M12 placement?
What per-tenant and per-task rights and future M53/M54/M58 publication controls are necessary before a claimed ability is usable?
How should task deprecation and model revision changes invalidate stale Genome claims without rewriting accepted M02/M06 history?
Which explicit UNKNOWN and contradiction behavior blocks arbitrary numeric rankings based on nonrepresentative vendor and benchmark claims?
Which negative tests must prevent old owner receipts replayed after tokenizer revision, tenant change or platform permission revocation?
How must future M10/M15 advisory routing consume real qualified Genome evidence without deciding executable M09/M11/M12 actions?

negativeScenarios.trigger: A copied text model card advertises embeddings but its tokenizer differs from the pinned model revision.
A generated-image vendor quality score omits the original M01 fidelity class, task population and independent M08 testing.
A stale video capability tag hides a changed frame cadence and undefined exact M04 temporal output semantics.
An audio-generation claim includes another tenant's voice persona without verified consent or derivative usage rights.
A 3D task card lists an unknown native DCC plugin as installed while process rights and operator coverage are absent.
A composite image-video-audio task returns only one media output while reporting full mandatory multimodal completion.
A structured model claims a provider operator that conflicts with frozen M03/M04 schemas and absent M16 compiler coverage.
A documentation-only SELF_REPORTED capability is promoted to OWNER_VERIFIED by a synthetic parser's successful test.
A future signed-looking owner receipt has an untrusted issuer, stale key or expired revocation record at the point of use.
A benchmark from another GPU and stale package revision is relabeled EMPIRICALLY_MEASURED for current model-card VRAM.
A backend declares attention operators supported but no actual M16/M17 trusted provider or custom-code validation exists.
A model cache reports warm GPU residency and an advisory planner projects a current owner-issued joint resource grant.
A revoked tenant's capability receipt is replayed for another tenant and reused on a modified model package revision.
A contradictory capability card is assigned a numerical winning risk rank for execution despite UNKNOWN and missing owner proof.

stop: M14 S02 Capability Genome is SOURCE_RESEARCH_ONLY. All eighteen new questions remain OPEN_UNRATED_PENDING_QUALIFIED_OWNER; fourteen future negatives are SPECIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED. No owner adoption, versioned capability contract, vendor/backend/operator/precision selection, current empirical model card, trust signature, legal rights, model download, native code or registry API. M09 B remains DIRECTION_ONLY; M09 C01 UNADOPTED_NOT_FROZEN and H01-H04 HIGH_FOR_FUTURE_FREEZE. M10-M13 runtime NOT_ADMITTED; no M14 GPU/OS/process/cloud/network/storage operation, public API or M11/M12 worker dispatch is admitted.
